title: senna surattensis subsp. sulfurea
intro: Senna surattensis subsp. sulfurea, commonly known as Yellow Senna, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health conditions. The health benefits of Yellow Senna include its ability to act as a laxative, helping to treat constipation and other gastrointestinal issues, as well as its potential to lower blood sugar levels and alleviate fever. The therapeutic actions of Yellow Senna are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sennosides, anthraquinones, and other compounds that stimulate bowel movements and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties.
